text: Refti pellet, Joomi maa an Nulaaɗo, wonannde ɓen huuwirɓe boneeji ɗin majjere battane majji, hay si tawii non ɓe tewi, kono ɓe tuubani Alla ɓaawo ɗen kuuɗe maɓɓe bonɗe, ɓe moƴƴini golle maɓɓe ɗe ɓe bonnunoo ɗen, pellet, Joomi maa, ɓaawo ngol tuubugol maɓɓe ɗon, ko Haforanoowo ɓe junuubi, Hinnotooɗo ɓe.
